title: Domain-Aware Lightweight Spectral-Grouped Convolutions for Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.12227v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) offers nondestructive assessment of fish freshness by detecting biochemical alterations across spectral bands. However, conventional deep learning approaches do not fully address the particular characteristics of HSI data, such as spectral dominance over spatial textures, ordinal label structure, and a small number of training samples. We propose SGNet (Spectral-Grouped Network), a lightweight architecture that separates spectral and spatial feature extraction using grouped convolutions and a depthwise spatial pathway. A dual attention mechanism that couples channel-wise squeeze-and-excitation with spatial gating adaptively highlights informative features. SGNet achieves 97.8% classification accuracy and 0.64 days mean absolute error (MAE) with just 4.75M parameters when tested on our newly developed 16-day refrigerator-stored salmon fillet dataset. translated_title: 领域感知轻量级光谱分组卷积用于高光谱鱼新鲜度分类
translated_abstract: 高光谱成像（HSI）通过检测跨光谱波段的生化变化，提供对鱼新鲜度的无损评估。然而，传统深度学习方法并未完全解决HSI数据的特定特性，例如光谱相对于空间纹理的主导性、有序标签结构以及少量训练样本。我们提出了SGNet（光谱分组网络），这是一种轻量级架构，通过分组卷积和深度可分离空间路径分离光谱和空间特征提取。一种耦合通道级挤压激励与空间门控的双重注意力机制自适应地突出信息丰富的特征。在我们新开发的16天冰箱储存三文鱼片数据集上测试时，SGNet实现了97.8%的分类准确率和0.64天的平均绝对误差（MAE），仅需4.75M参数。消融研究验证了每个组件的贡献。
tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级SGNet架构，通过光谱分组卷积和双重注意力机制，在少量训练样本下实现了高光谱鱼新鲜度分类的高精度（97.8%）和低误差（0.64天），且参数仅4.75M。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight SGNet architecture using spectral-grouped convolutions and dual attention, achieving high accuracy (97.8%) and low error (0.64 days) for hyperspectral fish freshness classification with few training samples and only 4.75M parameters.
